product_metadata.title: WORX WX030L 20V Power Share Cordless Cube Vac Compact Vacuum, Black
features: [POWERFUL SUCTION] Compact, on-the-go cleaning that is perfect for the home, office, and car
[EASY EMPTY] One-touch emptying system with removable HEPA filters and a tank that holds 6oz of dry debris
[DO IT ALL WITH THE SAME BATTERY] Worx Power Share is compatible with all Worx 20v and 40v tools, outdoor power and lifestyle products
[2-SPEEDS] Low for most cleaning tasks, and High for the messes that are stuck deeper down and require more suction
[FLEXIBLE HOSE] Retractable hose that extends up to 4ft for more reach, so you can get around corners or hold it up high to clean ceiling fans or window treatments
[STORES ANYWHERE] Cabinets, desk drawers, trunks, backpacks. It weighs only 3 lbs and its perfectly square size stacks nicely. Dirt Cup Capacity: 7.0 oz
[CREVICE NOZZLE] Get in-between car seats, around the console and the dash, under kitchen counters, and tackle the couch
description: A powerful-for-its-size portable vacuum that you don’t have to plug-in. It’s a clean person’s dream. You can take it anywhere, making it the perfect car or office vacuum. (When is the last time you vacuumed your office chair?) And with the crevice nozzle and brush attachments, you can dive in-between those couch cushions, and clean every last crumb out of your kitchen, too. It provides 10Kpa (Kilopascal) of suction. For reference, that’s about half the power of a standard upright vacuum. But the 20V Portable Vacuum from Worx is about 1/6th the size of one of those uprights, so it’s got plenty of power for its size. Besides, it’s not meant for regular vacuuming tasks, anyway. You’re never going to bring your full-size out to the car or into the office. That’s what this portable vacuum is for. And like your full-size, it’s only meant for dry debris. That makes it easy to empty and clean. Its tank capacity is 6 oz (that’s a lot of crumbs). It lasts up to 15 minutes on a single charge, which is a lot when you’re only doing spot cleaning and shorter chores. And its washable HEPA filter cleans the air as you vacuum, instead of kicking the debris back outside. The included 20V 2.0 Ah Max Lithium battery and charger gives you freedom from the cord and can be used on any other Worx 20V tool in the PowerShare family.
